root_cause.finding: The frozen runtime uses eos_token_id=15, whose tokenizer identity is <|im_end|>. Generation decodes the generated suffix with skip_special_tokens=false, so a normally terminated grid retains <|im_end|>. The frozen parser accepts only digits 0..9 and newline and performs no special-token handling; it therefore rejects a syntactically valid grid followed by the normal terminal EOS marker. Direct CPU verification confirms that the parser accepts 12\n34 but rejects 12\n34<|im_end|>. The 288-row result stores only parse booleans and a canonical invalid-output hash, not generated token IDs or raw suffix text, so the existing all-zero profile cannot distinguish this contract defect from genuinely non-grid model output.

smallest_repair.requirement: Preserve the completed V6 run, result, three profiles, batch-parity evidence, and terminal receipt byte-for-byte. Relabel their scientific interpretation as DECODER_VALIDITY_UNRESOLVED; COLLECTED_PASS remains a process outcome only, and the zero exact/parse rates must not be used as model-capability evidence.

Freeze a new target-blind decoder-output characterization subprotocol before any further model call. Pre-register a small fixed cohort spanning atomic, composition, and retention surfaces without consulting held-out outputs. Record generated token IDs, generated length, termination status, prompt hash, model/checkpoint identity, and batch identity before any scoring or reference access.

Define the candidate authoritative parser at token level: permit removal of exactly one terminal eos_token_id=15 and trailing pad_token_id=13 values only, then require the remaining sequence to contain exclusively digit token IDs 0..9 and newline token ID 10 forming one nonempty rectangular grid. Reject internal or leading special tokens, prose, JSON, repairs, multiple grids, ragged grids, and any other normalization. Do not select or tune this rule using target correctness.

Add CPU fixtures proving parity between token-level parsing and the established native ARC parser for valid and invalid cases, including terminal EOS, padding, missing EOS, internal EOS, extra special tokens, prose-equivalent tokens, ragged rows, and truncation. Include a frozen comparison of strict raw decoding versus terminal-EOS-aware parsing using only target-blind generation records.

Prepare a new immutable one-shot characterization launch package with exact source, checkpoint, dataset/cohort, parser, command, environment, runtime cap, nonce, and fresh output identities plus a no-model preflight. Do not execute it under this review. Submit the package for another Governor review before model loading or GPU inference.

review_trigger: A new hashed target-blind decoder-characterization brief containing the frozen token-level parser contract, fixed cohort, exact launch package, comprehensive CPU tests, fresh nonce and outputs, and local=origin=RunPod PASS_NO_MODEL_IMPORT evidence.

review_findings.finding: The reviewed brief, V6 result, terminal receipt, and atomic, composition, and retention profile hashes match the cited values. The live RunPod source commit equals local, upstream, and origin at 9839ddc83b4df28fee9ff4dff437e40c8f6c8455.

All 288 episodes completed, the terminal status is COLLECTED_PASS, no optimizer or training was used, and the 32-example B1-versus-batched validation has canonical agreement 1.0. These facts establish execution and batching consistency, not decoder validity.

The special-token-preserving output extraction and special-token-rejecting parser are incompatible with the configured normal EOS token. Because raw token sequences were not retained, the all-zero profile is scientifically non-identifying and cannot support capability or repair decisions.
